spotlight.placeholder: Search diagrams, objects, decisions and actions
spotlight.emptyHint: Check the spelling or try a broader term. Type ? for search tips.
spotlight.partialNotice: Only what this tab has loaded was searched: the workspace search is unavailable right now.

empty.title: No results for “{{query}}”
empty.scoped: Nothing in {{scope}} matches. Remove the filter to search everything.

spotlight.suggestionHint: Press ↵ to add this filter, then keep typing to narrow the results.

fix.keyHint: “{{typed}}:” is not a filter. Choose this to use {{key}}: instead.
fix.valueHint: “{{value}}” is not a {{key}}. Try one of: {{expected}}.

tips.kind: Only one kind of result: system, app, store, component, actor, group, diagram, flow, adr, connection or page. kind:object means any C4 object; values can be shortened (kind:sys) or combined (kind:app,store).
tips.tag: Objects and connections carrying a tag. Type tag: to pick from the tags in this landscape.
tips.tech: Anything built with a technology, matched on its name: tech:postgres finds PostgreSQL.
tips.in: Objects, groups, connections and flows placed on a diagram whose name matches.
tips.status: Objects by status (live, draft, down, unstable) or decision records by status (in-progress, approved, rejected).
tips.phrase: Quotes keep words together and in order.
tips.exclude: A leading minus removes matches: -legacy hides everything that mentions legacy. NOT legacy does the same.
tips.or: OR (in capitals) matches either side. Words without it must all match.
tips.has: Only results that have a description, a diagram, a technology or a tag.
tips.from: Connections by endpoint. Use from: and to: together to find one link.
